variant_decisions.evidence: ASV 'the son of Jeduthun' renders the personal name; the qere יְדוּתוּן and the ketiv ידיתון are orthographic variants of the same name and the English transliteration does not distinguish them. No ASV note is mapped to this unit. Base (qere) fallback carries the projection.
